scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Saving in Consumption of Energy and Water
other_conditions: The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
The enterprise must have undergone an energy/water audit conducted by a recognized institution or consultant.
The enterprise must demonstrate a minimum 10% reduction in energy or water consumption based on audit findings.
Audit reimbursement and equipment assistance are each available only once during the scheme’s operative period.
Equipment assistance is conditioned on achieving at least 10% savings of the average monthly consumption over the last 12 months before the audit.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 75% reimbursement of energy/water audit costs (max ₹50,000) and 25% financial assistance for equipment (max ₹20 lakh) to MSMEs that achieve at least 10% reduction in energy or water consumption.
